features.rationale: The description states that over 30 hours of workshops are part of the congress.
Three dancefloors are offered, which means more than one dance floor.
The listed socials include daytime socials.

features.quote: set in the luxurious Le Meridien Lav Hotel in Split, Croatia
features.rationale: The congress is held in the same hotel where dancers are invited to stay, so the event and accommodation share one venue.

features.quote: Accommodation at Hotel Le Meridien Lav:
features.rationale: A negotiated hotel room rate list is offered for the partner hotel, and the rates are not part of the congress pass.
